# Frontend State Machine — UI 元件狀態機（PrimaryButton + CopyButton）

> 來源：FRONTEND.md §5.2、PDD §13.1。
> 描述兩個關鍵 UI 元件的互動狀態：PrimaryButton（如「建立」「確認撤銷」）與 CopyButton（P03 揭示頁複製）。

## 1. PrimaryButton（提交類按鈕）

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Default : mount() [enabled] / renderInitialUI()

    Default --> Hover : pointerEnter() [not disabled] / applyHoverClass()
    Hover --> Default : pointerLeave() [always] / removeHoverClass()
    Default --> Focus : keyboardTabFocus() [always] / showFocusRing()
    Focus --> Default : blur() [always] / hideFocusRing()
    Hover --> Active : pointerDown() [not disabled] / applyActivePress()
    Focus --> Active : keyEnter() [not disabled] / applyActivePress()
    Active --> Loading : pointerUpOrEnterRelease() [validation passed] / triggerOnClick()
    Active --> Default : pointerUpOrCancel() [validation failed] / showInlineError()

    Loading --> Default : onSuccessOrError() [response received] / cleanup()
    Loading --> Disabled : disable() [parentSetDisabled] / disableInteractions()

    Default --> Disabled : disable() [externalCondition] / disableInteractions()
    Disabled --> Default : enable() [externalCondition cleared] / enableInteractions()

    state Default {
      entry: tabIndex = 0, ariaDisabled = false
      exit: noop
    }
    state Default : 預設狀態 — 可互動

    state Hover {
      entry: cursor = pointer, bg = primary-600
      exit: bg = primary-500
    }
    state Hover : 滑鼠懸停（pointer 設備）

    state Focus {
      entry: outline = 2px solid focus-ring
      exit: outline = none
    }
    state Focus : 鍵盤焦點（A11y AA）

    state Active {
      entry: transform scale(0.98)
      exit: transform scale(1)
    }
    state Active : 按下中（pointer / keyboard）

    state Loading {
      entry: showSpinner(), text = 建立中..., ariaBusy = true
      exit: hideSpinner(), text = 建立, ariaBusy = false
    }
    state Loading : 等待 server 回應；其他互動 disabled

    state Disabled {
      entry: ariaDisabled = true, opacity = 0.5
      exit: ariaDisabled = false, opacity = 1
    }
    state Disabled : 不可互動（外部 prop / loading）

    note right of Loading
      Loading 期間：
      - 鎖按鈕（防雙擊重複建立）
      - X / Esc / 遮罩無效避免中斷（PDD §6.4）
      - 顯示 spinner + 改 text 為「建立中...」
    end note

    note right of Disabled
      Disabled 觸發來源：
      - 表單 validation 未通過
      - 達 50 Token 上限
      - 父元件設定 disabled prop
    end note
```

## 2. CopyButton（P03 一次性揭示頁複製按鈕）

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle : mount() [textToCopy != null] / renderClipboardIcon()

    Idle --> Hover : pointerEnter() [always] / showTooltip("點擊複製")
    Hover --> Idle : pointerLeave() [always] / hideTooltip()
    Idle --> Focus : keyboardTab() [always] / showFocusRing()
    Focus --> Idle : blur() [always] / hideFocusRing()

    Idle --> Copying : pointerClickOrEnterPress() [textToCopy not empty] / invokeClipboardWriteText()
    Hover --> Copying : pointerClick() [always] / invokeClipboardWriteText()
    Focus --> Copying : keyEnterOrSpace() [always] / invokeClipboardWriteText()

    Copying --> Copied : navigatorClipboardSuccess() [Promise resolved] / dispatchToast(success), startTimer(3s)
    Copying --> Failed : navigatorClipboardError() [Promise rejected] / dispatchToast(error)

    Copied --> Idle : timer3sElapsed() [auto] / resetIcon()
    Failed --> Idle : pointerClickOrTimer5s() [retry or auto] / clearError()

    state Idle {
      entry: icon = clipboard, ariaLabel = 複製 Token
      exit: noop
    }
    state Idle : 預設 — 可互動

    state Hover {
      entry: cursor = pointer, bg = gray-100
      exit: bg = transparent
    }
    state Hover : 滑鼠懸停 + tooltip

    state Focus {
      entry: outline = 2px solid focus-ring
      exit: outline = none
    }
    state Focus : 鍵盤焦點

    state Copying {
      entry: ariaBusy = true
      exit: ariaBusy = false
    }
    state Copying : 等待 navigator.clipboard.writeText Promise

    state Copied {
      entry: icon = drawOnCheckmark, color = green-600, dispatchToast("已複製")
      exit: icon = clipboard, color = inherit
    }
    state Copied : 複製成功 — 圖示動畫 + 綠色 + Toast，3s 後自動恢復

    state Failed {
      entry: icon = exclamation, color = red-600, dispatchToast("複製失敗，請手動選取")
      exit: icon = clipboard, color = inherit
    }
    state Failed : 複製失敗 — 紅色錯誤圖示 + Toast

    note right of Copying
      navigator.clipboard.writeText 需要：
      - HTTPS context
      - User gesture（click / key）
      - Permissions-Policy: clipboard-write 允許
    end note

    note right of Failed
      失敗原因：
      - 非 HTTPS
      - 瀏覽器不支援
      - 使用者拒絕權限
      → 改顯示可選取明文文字
    end note
```

## 元件狀態對照（FRONTEND §5.2）

| 元件 | 狀態列表（FRONTEND 規格） | 對應 PDD |
|------|--------------------------|---------|
| **PrimaryButton** | default / hover / focus / active / disabled / loading | PDD §13.1 PrimaryButton |
| **CopyButton** | default / hover / focus / copied(3s) / failed | PDD §13.1 CopyButton + §5.3 |

## A11y 注意

| 行為 | ARIA 屬性 |
|------|----------|
| Loading | `aria-busy="true"`、`aria-disabled="true"` |
| Disabled | `aria-disabled="true"`、`tabindex="-1"` |
| Copied | 觸發 `aria-live="polite"` Toast 朗讀 |
| Failed | 觸發 `aria-live="assertive"` 錯誤朗讀 |

## reduced-motion 處理

`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` 時：
- PrimaryButton：移除 transform scale 動畫
- CopyButton：drawOnCheckmark → 直接顯示綠色靜態 ✓
